subject.title: docs: clarify ClawSweeper review and proof flow

question: Should OpenClaw codify this exact ClawSweeper proof and automatic-review-trigger flow in its root contributor and agent policy?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but the protected maintainer label and changes to root repository policy require human ownership of the permanent workflow contract.

options.title: Accept the unified guidance
options.body: Approve the three synchronized documentation surfaces after refreshing the branch and confirming the listed automatic trigger events still match production behavior.

options.title: Narrow the event contract
options.body: Keep the durable Evidence guidance but replace the exhaustive trigger list with less specific wording if maintainers do not want root policy coupled to dispatcher event details.

recommendation.title: Accept the unified guidance
recommendation.body: Approve the three synchronized documentation surfaces after refreshing the branch and confirming the listed automatic trigger events still match production behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available proof-workflow history candidate for implementation details, although final approval must come from a repository owner handling the protected label.
